8.22.1.2. iLock_Geography.pispec_configurator.GeoInstRule¶

class iLock_Geography.pispec_configurator.GeoInstRule(from_type, geo_type, doc)¶

Class containing a creation rule of geography object subtypes.

Supposed to be used after the creation of geography object(s) of a certain subtype, to be able to document the origin and creation of this type.

Methods

__init__(from_type, geo_type, doc)
type from_type:str
write(outf) Print method used by rules used to document the rule in reStructuredText format.
